name: P-005 plan dashboard renders derivedStatus and a dated Now note, marking a note the plan has moved past (headless Tauri shell)
summary: verify-tauri-headless booted papercusp-desktop from committed source 6a0f8070d683 on its own Xvfb display and ran the read-only drive script (navigation + DOM reads, no writes). It opened /adv?pdash=papercusp::derived-status-not-hand-written-2026-10-12 and read the plan dashboard. Setup before the run: plans:set-now stored a Now note (plan rev 36), then P-005 moved todo->wip (rev 37), so the stored note predates one item-status change. The run was strict (P005_REQUIRE_MOVED_PAST=1): it fails unless the Now card reports moved-past with both the stale class and the stale chip. Observed: the Status card rendered one derived row (in-flight P-005, held by su-e8ac9) and the Now card reported data-note-age=moved-past with class plan-dash__now--stale, the plan-dash-now-stale chip, and the age line 'moved past, written 22m ago, 1 status change since this note was written'. HARNESS_RESULT verdict=pass passed=3 failed=0 run=20261013T025912Z-1552420; script printed ASSERT_PASS rows=1 noteAge=moved-past.
